Northwind Software - Employee Policy Handbook v4.1
Page 10
Travel and Expenses
Business travel must be approved by your manager before you book it.
Booking travel
Book flights and hotels through the company travel desk at least 10 days in advance when
possible. Economy class is used for all flights within India.
Expense
Limit per day
Hotel in a metro city
Rs 6,000
Hotel in other cities
Rs 4,000
Meals
Rs 1,200
Claiming expenses
Submit expense claims in the HR portal within 30 days of the trip, with the bills attached.
Approved claims are paid with the next monthly salary.
Local travel
Cabs used for work are reimbursed at actual cost. Travel between home and the office is not a
business expense.
